annotations.title: Heating season in Poland: degree days, cold index, season cost

description: Use for the heating season: degree days, the cold of this winter against the norm, and the heating bill forecast. Indeks chłodu sezonu finwire (finwire_heating_season_index) and Koszt sezonu grzewczego finwire (finwire_heating_season_cost): heating degree days since 1 July (Eurostat method, IMGW-PIB synoptic stations) vs the 20-season norm for Poland and 17 cities, cold index (100 = norm, below = warmer), season forecast with an 80% interval only when the backtest gate passes (otherwise the reason), season heating cost of a 100 m2 house (gas, heat pump, coal, district heating), monthly means vs norm, coldest and warmest seasons since 1966/67.

city.description: 'polska' or city slug: warszawa, krakow, wroclaw, gdansk, poznan, lodz, katowice, torun, lublin, bialystok, szczecin, rzeszow, olsztyn, kielce, opole, zielona-gora, gorzow-wielkopolski. Gdynia and Sopot use gdansk, Bydgoszcz torun, Gliwice katowice. Omit for Poland with all cities.
